svg.title: Whose archive a document goes to
svg.desc: With per-user ownership, a run asks of every active document who owns it in Paperless. A document without an owner goes to the target user. A document whose owner Paperless didn't list, or that the account of the app owns while an upload waits for its owner, stays where its copy is. For every other owner, the run looks for one user of Nextcloud: the one that the table Paperless users with another Nextcloud ID names, or else the one with the same ID, whatever its case. Without such a user, or outside the group of the setting, the document goes to the target user, so that none is lost. When another user of Paperless has the same user of Nextcloud, it stays where its copy is, as the run doesn't guess. The connection checklist names each case. Otherwise it goes to that user. Its copy is written in the archive of that user, below the same base folder of their own files. With the option that also gives users what they may view, the run then asks Paperless who may view the document. When Paperless doesn't say, every other copy stays where it is, and the report counts the document. Otherwise each user of Nextcloud whose user of Paperless may view it, by itself or through a group, gets a copy at the same path. Then its copy leaves every other archive.
